From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dispute: INV-2026-1198 + legacy credit not applied

I've pulled the AR record for INV-2026-1198. CN-237 exists in our legacy billing platform (GL mapping: 210-CR-NONREC) but it wasn't linked to the invoice in our current ledger after the migration. The cash receipt was recorded (Receipt ID: R-4489) but allocated to the invoice without the credit adjustment, so the AR balance remained higher.

Proposed fix: create a reversing journal to clear the legacy credit bucket and apply a correcting JE to reduce INV-2026-1198. Draft JE header: JE-2027-042, Date 2027-03-16, Debit 210-CR-NONREC, Credit 110-AR (invoice). I'll attach a proposed JE workbook with narrative and mapping for revenue ops/recognition.

Questions for Rishi: does reversing the legacy credit hit revenue recognition or do we treat it as an AR reclassification (no rev impact)? Also, VAT — CN-237 is for services billed in 2026 and the customer indicates EU VAT reclaim consideration. Does this require any VAT adjustment before posting the JE?

Attachments: proposed-je-JE-2027-042.xlsx

- Marcus
Senior AR Analyst

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dispute: INV-2026-1198 + legacy credit not applied

Marcus — thanks for the write-up. Quick answers:
1) Revenue recognition: if CN-237 reduced billed revenue in 2026 (customer-facing credit), we need to mirror that in our rev module. But because the credit was never applied, our recognized revenue for the period likely overstated by the CN amount. We should post a corrective rev adjustment (revadj-2027-011) tied to JE-2027-042 to keep ASC 606 trails intact.
2) VAT: since the original invoice was in the EU region and CN-237 is dated 2026-12-15, VAT implications depend on whether the customer issued a valid credit for VAT on their side. For our bookkeeping, we should post the JE with the VAT component reversed (use VAT code EU-SVC-20) so the tax control account is updated. If Helios claims reclaim on their filing, they should be able to support with CN-237 — we'll include an audit note.

Next steps I propose: Marcus posts JE-2027-042 in draft and route to Lauren for sign-off on GL impact. I'll create revadj-2027-011 for the revenue ledger. Mina — once posted, can you confirm aging and notify the customer that the credit has been applied?

- Rishi
Revenue Accounting Lead
